_doc: qal/ptusk -- SKEPTIC re-run of the pulsed-inductor (ptu) vs switched-clamp (rtu) top-up comparison. Written as the SOLE file in this directory BEFORE any deck is built or run.
role: SKEPTIC. Re-run, do not read. I reproduce the analyst's load-bearing decks from scratch under MY OWN cache and MY OWN extractor, and I adjudicate the mechanism claim independently.
own_cache: PYMS_VAE_CACHE=<scratchpad>/vae_cache_ptusk -- built from scratch, nothing copied from skiptu, ptu, or any sibling.
writes: ONLY /usr/local/src/stat-sim/qal/ptusk. qal/skiptu and qal/ptu are READ-ONLY from here.

WHAT_I_MUST_DELIVER.a_rerun: re-run the BEST pulsed-inductor point and its MATCHED clamp point FROM SCRATCH (own decks, own cache, own zeros).
WHAT_I_MUST_DELIVER.b_police: per-gate settling at EVERY stage from the RAW .prn with MY OWN extractor, not from .mt0 and not via tuextract.
WHAT_I_MUST_DELIVER.c_mechanism: is the step coupling genuinely ABSENT under inductive delivery, or merely SMALLER? measured rail dV/dt in BOTH forms + the predecessor's rail excursion.
WHAT_I_MUST_DELIVER.d_cost: is the top-up's OWN cost counted -- HS gate, freewheel gate, OUT switch gates, the inductor, any bias.
WHAT_I_MUST_DELIVER.e_separation: independently recompute HIGH/LOW separation by depth against the 3.42 mV sigma-Vt floor.
WHAT_I_MUST_DELIVER.f_verdict: does the correct top-up form change the committed outcome, and with what confidence.

ACCEPTANCE_inherited_verbatim.A1_settling: EVERY gate in ALL stages >= 90% settled at its own stage boundary. pull-DOWN 100*(1 - V(o)/rail_k), pull-UP 100*(V(o)/rail_k), rail_k read at the SAME boundary instant. WORST gate, never an average.
ACCEPTANCE_inherited_verbatim.A2_threshold: delivered input HIGH >= 0.4400 V at EVERY stage.
ACCEPTANCE_inherited_verbatim.A4_boundary: bound_k = min(c_k + T, d_k - EDGE) for a hop-charged bank, d_k - EDGE for a head bank, EDGE = 2 ps.
ACCEPTANCE_inherited_verbatim.A5_instrument: committed robust single-hop point reproduced under MY cache: L=15nH W=30um dV=1.2 -> t_hop 65.49500982344826 ps, VBEND 0.7138163, VBPK 0.8368896, 8/8 settled. rel < 1e-6 or I do not report.
ACCEPTANCE_inherited_verbatim.A6_ZCS: interrupted |IZ| < 1.0 uA at each switch open, zeros re-probed per L and per hop.
ACCEPTANCE_inherited_verbatim.A7_metering: 1F integrator or INTEG-I(Vsrc)+PARAM only; 1F integrators ALWAYS t0-referenced (they carry a t=0 pedestal).

MY_DISCRIMINATORS_fixed_in_advance.S1_slope: max rising dV/dt on the topped rail (rail3) over a window containing NO hop switching, computed by centred finite difference on the printed .prn grid, V/ns. Clamp vs pulsed at the SAME operating point.
MY_DISCRIMINATORS_fixed_in_advance.S2_victim: the damage measured ON THE VICTIM: stage 2's pull-DOWN outputs (the feeding stage's LOW), reported as topped-row MINUS free-control in the same window, mV.
MY_DISCRIMINATORS_fixed_in_advance.S3_normalised: damage PER mV OF RAIL ACTUALLY DELIVERED. A form that delivers less rail must not be credited for coupling less in absolute terms. This is the fair comparison and I fix it now, before seeing the data.
MY_DISCRIMINATORS_fixed_in_advance.S4_pred_rail: the feeding stage's rail at its own boundary, both forms vs free.
MY_DISCRIMINATORS_fixed_in_advance.S5_rail_level: rail3 at its boundary, and the resulting pMOS overdrive over the MEASURED |Vtp| = 0.4403 V.
MY_DISCRIMINATORS_fixed_in_advance.S6_separation: min(pull-up output) - max(pull-down output) within each stage, mV, by bank depth, vs the 3.42 mV floor.
MY_DISCRIMINATORS_fixed_in_advance.no_post_hoc: S1-S6 are fixed here. Any metric I invent after seeing data is reported as EXPLORATORY and kept OUT of the verdict.

CLAIMS_I_AM_SENT_TO_CHECK_stated_before_.brief_hypothesis: a pulsed inductor CANNOT produce a voltage step, so the reported negative result may be an ARTEFACT of the substituted clamp. I test this and I am willing to overturn the committed verdict if it holds.
CLAIMS_I_AM_SENT_TO_CHECK_stated_before_.analyst_A8_defect: analyst claims the ptu PROBE deck instantiates NO top-up devices, so every pulsed row fails the 1.0 uA A6 gate. VERIFIED BY ME ON DISK BEFORE RUNNING: p1_z_s4_ptu_T200_dv1200_L1_t12_C8_f.cir differs from the free probe by exactly ONE line, a DANGLING 'VTSUP tsup 0 1.2' on an unconnected node -- electrically identical. Recorded here so it cannot look post-hoc.
CLAIMS_I_AM_SENT_TO_CHECK_stated_before_.analyst_best_row: analyst reports best corrected-pulsed = s4/T200/dV1.2/Ltu=1nH/t_on=24ps/Cna=8fF and best-stage-3 34.08% at t_on=12. I re-run BOTH t_on and pick the best myself.
CLAIMS_I_AM_SENT_TO_CHECK_stated_before_.two_numbers_I_also_could_not_find: the brief's 0.1545 -> 0.0587 V and -0.0188 V. I scan for them myself and record the result BEFORE measuring.

PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_with_falsifiers.K1: the pulsed form will show a LOWER max dV/dt than the clamp. FALSIFIER: within 2x. If it is merely ~2x rather than orders of magnitude, the brief's 'no voltage discontinuity' claim is REFUTED as stated and I say so.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_with_falsifiers.K2: per mV of rail delivered, I expect the pulsed form's backward coupling to be NO BETTER than the clamp's. FALSIFIER: pulsed coupling per delivered mV materially below the clamp's.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_with_falsifiers.K3: the pulsed form will not exceed the clamp's rail3 = 1.069085 V. FALSIFIER: it does, with positive delivered charge.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_with_falsifiers.K4: separation in the SKIP chain will NOT collapse below 3.42 mV by depth 3, because banks 3/4 are re-powered from fresh hops off ideally pre-charged heads. NOTE: this CONTRADICTS the brief's premise and the analyst's H4. I state it before measuring.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_with_falsifiers.K5: I expect the committed bottom line to survive. Stated now so a confirmation cannot be dressed up as a discovery.

HONESTY.labels: every number labelled MEASURED / DERIVED / ASSUMED.
HONESTY.confirmation_is_a_result: if the pulsed form does not change the outcome, that is a clean confirmation and is reported as one.
HONESTY.loudness: if it DOES change the outcome, I say so loudly and name the clause that needs amending.
HONESTY.shallow_stack: all numbers SHALLOW-STACK; sg13lv_compat.sp zeroes ad/as/pd/ps so device numbers are LOWER bounds.
